PSA 85:1.KJV: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
PSA 85:1.BHSA: רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שׁבות יַעֲקֹֽב׃

PSA 85:2.KJV: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
PSA 85:2.BHSA: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֹ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

PSA 85:3.KJV: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

PSA 85:4.KJV: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
PSA 85:4.BHSA: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃

PSA 85:5.KJV: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
PSA 85:5.BHSA: הַלְעֹולָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף־בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

PSA 85:6.KJV: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

PSA 85:7.KJV: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

PSA 85:8.KJV: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
PSA 85:8.BHSA: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֢ל׀ יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י׀ יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁלֹ֗ום אֶל־עַמֹּ֥ו וְאֶל־חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל־יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃

PSA 85:9.KJV: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
PSA 85:9.BHSA: אַ֤ךְ׀ קָרֹ֣וב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁעֹ֑ו לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּבֹ֣וד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃

PSA 85:10.KJV: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

PSA 85:11.KJV: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
PSA 85:11.BHSA: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃

PSA 85:12.KJV: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
PSA 85:12.BHSA: גַּם־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטֹּ֑וב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃

PSA 85:13.KJV: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
PSA 85:13.BHSA: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃
